QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Utah? Utah!
QuestInfo.0: You start to search for Utah, per Camila's request, in Henesys Ruins. He was in Creepy Humming Forest Trail. Go and talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Utah is edgier than you remember, for understandable reasons. Since he still has something to do out here, he's asked you to tell #bCamila#k he'll be home soon.
QuestInfo.2: You told Camila Utah will be home soon. Close as he is to town, Camila still worries about him.

0.0: Camila sent you? That's thoughtful of her. And you. Yeah, I've been away from home for a couple of days now, haven't I?
0.1: I still have something to do out here, though, so I'm going to be late. Just tell her I'll be fine, will you? I'll be home soon. Tell her that too.

no.0: Yeah, I guess you've got your own business. Let's talk later.

yes.0: Utah's okay...? Thank you so much! I was worried the Cygnus Knights had gotten their hands on him.
yes.1: There was a time when I wouldn't have worried, with him being so close to home. But ever since the Cygnus Knights came at us, there's been nothing but fear and chaos all around.
yes.2: You want to know how we stop the Cygnus Knights? We go straight to the source. Get rid of the Empress.

npc.0: I still have something to do out here, though, so I'm going to be late. Just tell her I'll be fine, will you? I'll be home soon. Tell her that too.
